name: migrations
description: Schema changes that must survive production-sized tables.

rules.rule:
- No data backfill or full-table rewrite inside a deploy-time migration; run it as a separate job.
- New indexes on big tables are built concurrently where the database allows; no long locks.
- Deploy order works: the migration lands before code that reads the new column, and old code still runs against the new schema.
- A new column used in a hot WHERE/JOIN/ORDER BY has an index or a stated reason.
